issue.title: Unblock E2 again: a green macOS core, core cuts the steward really dispatches, and a cutover wait that tracks master
issue.description: sase-core master CI is green on macOS again, so the daily cut can merge and publish a core. The release steward counts only merge-capable release-plz runs as core cuts, so its CORE_LAG action proposes a real cut and a heal run never hides a failed cut. sase-1oe.4 waits on the core pin that origin/master names now, not on a frozen workspace pin, so it can rehearse and raise the E2 handover gate.

issue.description: macos-core: find why wal_mode_probe_consumes_conversion_budget spends 750 ms to 1.2 s of a 250 ms budget on macos-latest. Fix the product if it overshoots its wall-clock budget, or fix the oracle if the overshoot is outside the budget's control, without loosening the bound. Prove that master CI is green on both OSes and that a merge-capable cut publishes a complete core after the fix.

issue.title: Only merge-capable release-plz runs count as core cuts for the steward
issue.description: real-cuts: the steward's cut facts drop push and six-hourly heal runs, which never merge the release PR. CORE_LAG then proposes a real cut, and a non-merging success no longer supersedes a failed cut. The cut_budget decision bounds how often the steward dispatches. Prove it with a live read-only --once.

payload.entry: Monitor aecm017a7yjz (sase-1oe.4--mon-0, WAITING CORE) is still running in workspace sase_10 and polls `python3 tools/ratchet_core_pin --check` against that frozen working tree. No sase-1oe.4 continuation is running (followup_agent is null). Confirmed from `sase monitor resume -h`, docs/reference/automation/monitor-operations.md, and tests/monitor/test_monitor_resume.py::test_resume_rejects_stopped_monitor that resuming a monitor stopped with `sase monitor stop` is ineligible (inspection-only) and stop never launches the recorded follow-up. Left the monitor running; the CORRECTED WAIT PROCEDURE note on sase-1oe.4 covers its next wait.

LOCAL FIX CHECKPOINT (2026-10-29 UTC): GitHub CI run 40726794062 reproduced the existing macOS failure at 961.12475ms for a 250ms budget; Ubuntu passed. The Mac host was unreachable. Replaced SQLite nominal busy_timeout waits with a per-connection busy handler using the operation’s absolute Instant deadline for WAL setup and store reads/writes. Added a deterministic simulated scheduler-oversleep test and routed wal_mode_probe_consumes_conversion_budget through with_write_store. just fmt passed. sase tool run check ff5b0cd52a33355cb6323e2456608053 passed: 5549 core tests, 405 gateway tests, 360 macro-LSP tests, and all remaining suites; the two affected tests passed. This is local-only evidence; the change still needs the host commit, green master ci.yml on both OSes, and the next scheduled release-plz cut to publish a complete core. Follow core_cut=wait; do not dispatch a cut.

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Investigate intermittent bead-cache parity assertion in sase-core CI — run https://github.com/sase-org/sase-core/actions/runs/40797498289 at 0fd85e4ab6e61ab0aec9be6b85cdb0026e71816c passed the macOS job and both WAL deadline tests, but Ubuntu failed bead_read_model_parity::concurrent_readers_see_consistent_snapshots at integration/bead_read_model_parity.rs:934 (cache is stale: the next read rebuilds). Ubuntu passed in successor master run 40800810108 at 95dc0c10db564ad31bc7e63761dd4a6fab4f40e3; the intervening diff only changes release_steward files, with identical cache code/test. Search found related closed phase sase-1io.7.1 (concurrent read-model cache safety), but no exact cache-is-stale task match. This is separate from the repaired ToolRun connection budget; no new bead created.

LIVE-PROOF CHECKPOINT (2026-10-29 UTC): Prior work landed as sase-core 0fd85e4ab6e61ab0aec9be6b85cdb0026e71816c, an ancestor of origin/master 95dc0c10db564ad31bc7e63761dd4a6fab4f40e3. Reviewed the committed fix: the busy handler uses one absolute Instant deadline, keeps the deterministic oversleep test and the 425ms assertion, and preserves the owed WAL-conversion attempt from preceding df14e8f4. Run 40797498289 proved macOS green; Ubuntu had the separate cache assertion recorded above. Current master CI 40800810108 has green Ubuntu, import smoke and workflow scripts; macOS is still running. Latest published release remains v0.43.0, which predates the fix. Approved core_cut=wait remains final: no release dispatch, manual merge, pin, setting or memory changes. Both checkouts are clean; lint_and_test read, no new file changes requiring checks, and epic-symbols is empty. Remaining scope is bounded CI/publication evidence, not an oversized coding remainder, so no child epic is needed. Hand the current CI run to a 3h SASE monitor, then monitor the next scheduled merge-capable cut with a 36h deadline. Accept only green CI on both OSes and a complete published core containing 0fd85e4a; record version and peeled tag SHA here and on sase-1oe.4 (fixing its note #3), rerun epic-symbols, and close only sase-1pi.1.

GREEN MASTER CI (2026-10-29 UTC): https://github.com/sase-org/sase-core/actions/runs/40800810108 completed successfully at 95dc0c10db564ad31bc7e63761dd4a6fab4f40e3, a verified descendant of deadline fix 0fd85e4ab6e61ab0aec9be6b85cdb0026e71816c. All four jobs succeeded: Ubuntu cargo fmt/clippy/test (job 123208213719), macOS cargo fmt/clippy/test (job 123208213744, completed 02:01:28Z), maturin build/import smoke, and release workflow scripts. The prior macOS success at the fix itself remains run 40797498289. Latest published core is still v0.43.0, published 2026-10-27T13:47:53Z, so the publication condition remains unmet. Approved core_cut=wait: handing the next scheduled daily merge-capable release-plz run to a zero-weight monitor with an explicit 36h deadline; push/heal runs with Merge release PR skipped are excluded. The continuation must verify merge and containing complete publication, record version/tag SHA and PyPI file completeness, annotate sase-1oe.4 note #3 as fixed, then check epic-symbols and close only this phase. On another cut failure, record its CORE_CUT_RED evidence as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP and keep this phase incomplete. No file, pin, setting or memory changes; both checkouts clean and lint_and_test read. Remaining work is external release proof only.
